student:applications.emptyText.en: Pick a program from your matches to start. You can prepare at your own pace.
student:applications.emptyText.cur: Pilih program dari daftar kecocokan Anda untuk memulai. Anda bisa menyiapkannya sesuai kecepatan Anda sendiri.

student:applications.subtitle.en: Each application has its own checklist. Documents that have already been checked are reused automatically.
student:applications.subtitle.cur: Setiap pendaftaran punya daftar periksa sendiri. Dokumen yang sudah dicek dipakai ulang secara otomatis.

student:dashboard.arrival.noFlight.en: Add your flight so we can plan your pickup and first days.
student:dashboard.arrival.noFlight.cur: Tambahkan penerbangan Anda agar kami bisa merencanakan penjemputan dan hari-hari pertama Anda.

student:dashboard.arrival.title.en: Your visa is ready. Let's plan your arrival
student:dashboard.arrival.title.cur: Visa Anda sudah siap. Ayo rencanakan kedatangan Anda

student:dashboard.counselor.noneText.en: With a plan, the Hangyul team reviews your documents, essays and strategy in your language.
student:dashboard.counselor.noneText.cur: Dengan paket layanan, tim Hangyul meninjau dokumen, esai, dan strategi pendaftaran Anda dalam bahasa Anda.

student:dashboard.deadlines.empty.en: No deadlines in the coming weeks.
student:dashboard.deadlines.empty.cur: Tidak ada tenggat dalam beberapa minggu ke depan.

student:dashboard.stageText.APPLY.en: You're preparing applications. One step at a time.
student:dashboard.stageText.APPLY.cur: Anda sedang menyiapkan pendaftaran. Satu langkah demi satu langkah.

student:dashboard.stageText.ARRIVAL.en: Your visa is ready. Time to plan your arrival!
student:dashboard.stageText.ARRIVAL.cur: Visa Anda sudah siap. Saatnya merencanakan kedatangan Anda!

student:dashboard.stageText.DECISION.en: Your applications are with the universities.
student:dashboard.stageText.DECISION.cur: Pendaftaran Anda sedang di tangan universitas.

student:dashboard.stageText.ENROLL.en: Congratulations on your offer! Let's secure your place.
student:dashboard.stageText.ENROLL.cur: Selamat atas tawaran Anda! Mari amankan tempat Anda.

student:dashboard.stageText.EXPLORE.en: Let's start by getting to know you.

student:dashboard.stageText.MATCH.en: Your matches are ready. Choose where to apply.
student:dashboard.stageText.MATCH.cur: Hasil kecocokan Anda sudah siap. Pilih tempat Anda akan mendaftar.

student:dashboard.stageText.PROFILE.en: Finish your profile to see your personal matches.
student:dashboard.stageText.PROFILE.cur: Lengkapi profil Anda untuk melihat program yang cocok khusus untuk Anda.

student:dashboard.stageText.STUDENT_LIFE.en: Welcome to Korea. We're still here if you need us.
student:dashboard.stageText.STUDENT_LIFE.cur: Selamat datang di Korea. Kami tetap di sini jika Anda membutuhkan kami.

student:dashboard.stageText.VISA.en: You're admitted. Next: your student visa.
student:dashboard.stageText.VISA.cur: Anda sudah diterima. Selanjutnya: visa pelajar Anda.

student:documents.drawer.expiredText.en: Upload a current copy so your applications stay valid.
student:documents.drawer.expiredText.cur: Unggah salinan yang masih berlaku agar pendaftaran Anda tetap sah.

student:documents.drawer.fixDefault.en: This document needs a change. Fix it and upload a new version.
student:documents.drawer.fixDefault.cur: Dokumen ini perlu diperbaiki. Unggah versi baru setelah diperbaiki.

student:documents.drawer.inReview.en: We're reviewing this document. You don't need to do anything right now.
student:documents.drawer.inReview.cur: Kami sedang meninjau dokumen ini. Saat ini Anda tidak perlu melakukan apa pun.

student:documents.legal.intro.en: Mark each step as done when you complete it. We'll check the final document.
student:documents.legal.intro.cur: Tandai setiap langkah sebagai selesai saat Anda menyelesaikannya. Kami akan memverifikasi dokumen akhirnya.

student:documents.privacy.short.en: Stored encrypted. Only you and the Hangyul team can open it until you submit an application.
student:documents.privacy.short.cur: Disimpan dalam bentuk terenkripsi. Hanya Anda dan tim Hangyul Univ yang bisa membukanya sampai Anda mengirim pendaftaran.

student:documents.upload.countryHint.en: Decides whether an apostille is needed.

student:documents.upload.fileHint.en: PDF, JPG, PNG or WEBP, up to {{mb}} MB.
student:documents.upload.fileHint.cur: PDF, JPG, PNG, atau WEBP, maksimal {{mb}} MB.

student:documents.upload.subtitle.en: A clear scan or phone photo is fine. We'll check it and let you know if anything needs fixing.
student:documents.upload.subtitle.cur: Hasil pindaian yang jelas atau foto dari ponsel sudah cukup. Kami akan memeriksanya dan memberi tahu jika ada yang perlu diperbaiki.

student:essays.emptyText.en: Essays are created automatically when you start an application, or you can start one yourself.
student:essays.emptyText.cur: Esai dibuat otomatis saat Anda memulai pendaftaran, atau Anda bisa memulainya sendiri.

student:essays.new.subtitle.en: For practice or for a university that isn't listed yet.
student:essays.new.subtitle.cur: Untuk latihan atau untuk universitas yang belum tercantum.

student:home.closestSub.en: You don't meet every published requirement yet. Here is exactly what's missing.
student:home.closestSub.cur: Anda belum memenuhi semua persyaratan yang dipublikasikan. Inilah tepatnya yang masih kurang.

student:home.docAction.TOO_OLD.en: Too old. Get a new copy
student:home.docAction.TOO_OLD.cur: Terbit terlalu lama. Urus salinan baru

student:home.recommendedSub.en: Programs where you meet the published requirements.
student:home.recommendedSub.cur: Program yang persyaratan publikasinya sudah Anda penuhi.

student:housing.noDorms.en: This university hasn't published dormitory information yet.

student:housing.noUni.en: Housing opens up with your first application

student:housing.noUniText.en: Once you've applied, we'll show dormitory options and costs for that university.

student:housing.subtitle.en: Compare dormitory options and keep track of your housing steps.

student:login.aside.eyebrow.en: Study in Korea, step by step
student:login.aside.eyebrow.cur: Kuliah di Korea, langkah demi langkah

student:login.aside.note.en: Thousands of small steps, one clear next step at a time.
student:login.aside.note.cur: Ribuan langkah kecil, satu langkah berikutnya yang jelas setiap kali.

student:login.aside.point1.en: See which programs fit you, with clear reasons for each.
student:login.aside.point1.cur: Lihat program mana yang cocok untuk Anda, lengkap dengan alasan yang jelas untuk masing-masing.

student:login.aside.point2.en: Keep every document in one secure vault and reuse it across applications.
student:login.aside.point2.cur: Simpan semua dokumen di satu brankas aman dan pakai ulang untuk setiap pendaftaran.

student:login.aside.point3.en: Prepare with real people on the Hangyul team who speak your language.
student:login.aside.point3.cur: Bekerja sama dengan konselor sungguhan yang berbicara dalam bahasa Anda.

student:login.aside.text.en: From your first search to the day you land at Incheon, Hangyul Univ shows you what to do next, and why.
student:login.aside.text.cur: Dari pencarian pertama hingga hari Anda mendarat di Incheon, Hangyul Univ menunjukkan apa yang harus dilakukan selanjutnya, dan alasannya.

student:login.aside.title.en: One calm place for every step to a Korean university.
student:login.aside.title.cur: Satu tempat yang tenang untuk setiap langkah menuju universitas di Korea.

student:login.subtitle.en: Continue where you left off. Your checklist, messages and deadlines are waiting.
student:login.subtitle.cur: Lanjutkan dari tempat terakhir Anda. Daftar periksa, pesan, dan tenggat Anda sudah menunggu.

student:messages.emptyText.en: Ask anything: documents, deadlines, life in Korea.
student:messages.emptyText.cur: Tanyakan apa saja: dokumen, tenggat, kehidupan di Korea.

student:messages.hint.en: Enter to send · Shift + Enter for a new line
student:messages.hint.cur: Enter untuk mengirim · Shift + Enter untuk baris baru

student:messages.new.subtitle.en: The Hangyul team will reply here.
student:messages.new.subtitle.cur: Tim Hangyul Univ akan membalas di sini.

student:messages.pickText.en: Or start a new one with the Hangyul team.
student:messages.pickText.cur: Atau mulai percakapan baru dengan tim Hangyul.

student:messages.subtitle.en: Talk with the Hangyul team. Replies usually arrive within one business day.
student:messages.subtitle.cur: Mengobrol dengan tim Hangyul. Balasan biasanya datang dalam satu hari kerja.

student:messages.visibility.en: Visible to you and the Hangyul team
student:messages.visibility.cur: Terlihat oleh Anda dan tim Hangyul

student:notifications.emptyText.en: We'll let you know when something needs your attention.
student:notifications.emptyText.cur: Kami akan memberi tahu Anda jika ada yang perlu perhatian Anda.

student:notifications.subtitle.en: Updates about your applications, documents and messages.
student:notifications.subtitle.cur: Kabar terbaru tentang pendaftaran, dokumen, dan pesan Anda.

student:onboarding.basics.legalText.en: Official documents from {{country}} usually need this step before Korean universities accept them: {{path}}. We'll guide you through it when the time comes.
student:onboarding.basics.legalText.cur: Dokumen resmi dari {{country}} biasanya memerlukan langkah ini sebelum diterima universitas Korea: {{path}}. Kami akan memandu Anda saat waktunya tiba.

student:onboarding.basics.residenceHint.en: Some embassies accept visa applications only from residents of their own country.
student:onboarding.basics.residenceHint.cur: Beberapa kedutaan hanya menerima pengajuan visa dari penduduk setempat.

student:onboarding.education.gpaHint.en: Enter your average on your school's own scale.
student:onboarding.education.gpaHint.cur: Masukkan nilai rata-rata Anda sesuai skala sekolah Anda.

student:onboarding.education.level.en: Highest level completed or in progress
student:onboarding.education.level.cur: Jenjang tertinggi yang sudah selesai atau sedang ditempuh

student:onboarding.education.method.en: How we compare grades: we convert your GPA to a 0–100% score using a simple linear scale (your GPA ÷ scale maximum). Universities may convert grades differently. The Hangyul team can add a note if your school uses a special scale.
student:onboarding.education.method.cur: Cara kami membandingkan nilai: IPK Anda dikonversi menjadi skor 0–100% dengan skala linear sederhana (IPK Anda ÷ nilai maksimum skala). Tiap universitas bisa mengonversi nilai dengan cara berbeda. Tim Hangyul dapat menambahkan catatan jika sekolah Anda memakai skala khusus.

student:onboarding.education.previewEmpt.en: Enter a GPA and its scale to see the normalized score.
student:onboarding.education.previewEmpt.cur: Masukkan IPK dan skalanya untuk melihat skor yang dinormalkan.

student:onboarding.goals.degreeSub.LANGU.en: Start with Korean, at your own pace
student:onboarding.goals.degreeSub.LANGU.cur: Belajar bahasa Korea dulu. Awal yang umum dan ringan

student:onboarding.goals.degreeSub.TRANS.cur: Melanjutkan kuliah yang sudah Anda mulai

student:onboarding.goals.fieldsHint.en: Choose as many as you like.

student:onboarding.goals.intake.en: When would you like to start?

student:onboarding.goals.intakeHint.en: Korean universities start in spring (March) and fall (September).
student:onboarding.goals.intakeHint.cur: Universitas Korea dimulai pada musim semi (Maret) dan musim gugur (September).

student:onboarding.language.english.en: How would you rate your English?
student:onboarding.language.english.cur: Bagaimana Anda menilai bahasa Inggris Anda?

student:onboarding.language.korean.en: How would you rate your Korean?
student:onboarding.language.korean.cur: Bagaimana Anda menilai bahasa Korea Anda?

student:onboarding.language.testSub.TOPI.en: Test of Proficiency in Korean, levels 1–6

student:onboarding.language.tests.en: Which tests have you taken or plan to take?
student:onboarding.language.tests.cur: Tes apa yang sudah atau akan Anda ikuti?

student:onboarding.language.testsHint.en: Skip this if you haven't started yet.
student:onboarding.language.testsHint.cur: Lewati ini jika Anda belum mulai.

student:onboarding.passport.expiryHint.en: It should be valid for your whole study period if possible.
student:onboarding.passport.expiryHint.cur: Sebaiknya berlaku selama seluruh masa studi Anda jika memungkinkan.

student:onboarding.passport.has.en: Do you have a valid passport?
student:onboarding.passport.has.cur: Apakah Anda punya paspor yang masih berlaku?

student:onboarding.passport.inKorea.en: Are you in Korea right now?
student:onboarding.passport.inKorea.cur: Apakah Anda sedang berada di Korea?

student:onboarding.passport.noSub.en: That's okay. You'll need it later for the visa
student:onboarding.passport.noSub.cur: Tidak apa-apa. Anda akan memerlukannya nanti untuk visa

student:onboarding.passport.numberHint.en: Optional. We only keep the last digits; the full number stays on your passport document.
student:onboarding.passport.numberHint.cur: Opsional. Kami hanya menyimpan beberapa digit terakhir; nomor lengkapnya tetap ada di dokumen paspor Anda.

student:onboarding.passport.previousHint.en: This can change which visa steps apply to you.
student:onboarding.passport.previousHint.cur: Ini bisa mengubah langkah visa yang berlaku untuk Anda.

student:onboarding.passport.previousVisa.en: Have you held a Korean visa before?
student:onboarding.passport.previousVisa.cur: Apakah Anda pernah memiliki visa Korea?

student:onboarding.preferences.budget.en: Yearly budget for tuition and living costs
student:onboarding.preferences.budget.cur: Anggaran tahunan untuk biaya kuliah dan biaya hidup

student:onboarding.preferences.budgetHin.en: A rough range is fine. We use it to mark programs that may cost more than your budget.
student:onboarding.preferences.budgetHin.cur: Kisaran kasar sudah cukup. Kami memakainya untuk menandai program yang mungkin melebihi anggaran Anda.

student:onboarding.preferences.housing.en: Where would you like to live?

student:onboarding.preferences.housingSu.en: Most first-year international students choose this
student:onboarding.preferences.housingSu.cur: Pilihan sebagian besar mahasiswa internasional tahun pertama

student:onboarding.preferences.regionsHi.en: Leave empty if anywhere in Korea is fine.
student:onboarding.preferences.regionsHi.cur: Kosongkan jika di mana saja di Korea tidak masalah.

student:onboarding.preferences.scholarsh.cur: Bagus jika ada, tapi tidak wajib

student:onboarding.preferences.scholarsh.en: We'll highlight programs with scholarships you may qualify for
student:onboarding.preferences.scholarsh.cur: Kami akan menyorot program dengan beasiswa yang mungkin bisa Anda dapatkan

student:onboarding.sponsor.goal.en: What would you like to do after graduating?
student:onboarding.sponsor.goal.cur: Apa yang ingin Anda lakukan setelah lulus?

student:onboarding.sponsor.goalHint.en: One or two sentences is plenty. It helps with your study plan later.
student:onboarding.sponsor.goalHint.cur: Satu atau dua kalimat sudah cukup. Ini akan membantu rencana studi Anda nanti.

student:onboarding.sponsor.goalPh.en: e.g. Work in marketing between Korean and Vietnamese companies.
student:onboarding.sponsor.goalPh.cur: mis. Bekerja di bidang pemasaran antara perusahaan Korea dan Indonesia.

student:onboarding.sponsor.who.en: Who will pay for your studies?
student:onboarding.sponsor.who.cur: Siapa yang akan membiayai studi Anda?

student:onboarding.sponsor.whoHint.en: Visa applications need proof of funds from this person or organization.
student:onboarding.sponsor.whoHint.cur: Pengajuan visa memerlukan bukti dana dari orang atau lembaga ini.

student:onboarding.steps.basics.subtitle.en: This tells us which documents and visa rules apply to you.
student:onboarding.steps.basics.subtitle.cur: Ini memberi tahu kami dokumen dan aturan visa mana yang berlaku untuk Anda.

student:onboarding.steps.education.subti.en: We use this to check entry requirements. An estimate is fine for now.
student:onboarding.steps.education.subti.cur: Kami memakai ini untuk memeriksa syarat masuk. Perkiraan juga tidak apa-apa untuk saat ini.

student:onboarding.steps.education.title.en: Tell us about your current education

student:onboarding.steps.goals.subtitle.en: Pick what feels right today. You can explore other options anytime.
student:onboarding.steps.goals.subtitle.cur: Pilih yang terasa pas hari ini. Anda bisa menjelajahi pilihan lain kapan saja.

student:onboarding.steps.goals.title.en: What would you like to study?

student:onboarding.steps.language.subtit.en: An official score matches you with more programs, but many students start without one.
student:onboarding.steps.language.subtit.cur: Skor resmi membuat Anda cocok dengan lebih banyak program, tetapi banyak mahasiswa memulai tanpa skor.

student:onboarding.steps.language.title.en: How are your Korean and English?
student:onboarding.steps.language.title.cur: Bagaimana kemampuan bahasa Korea dan Inggris Anda?

student:onboarding.steps.passport.subtit.en: Only the basics. We never ask for your full passport number here.
student:onboarding.steps.passport.subtit.cur: Hanya data dasar. Di sini kami tidak akan meminta nomor paspor lengkap Anda.

student:onboarding.steps.preferences.sub.en: Budget, scholarships and housing help us rank programs for you.
student:onboarding.steps.preferences.sub.cur: Anggaran, beasiswa, dan tempat tinggal membantu kami mengurutkan program untuk Anda.

student:onboarding.steps.preferences.tit.en: What matters to you in daily life?
student:onboarding.steps.preferences.tit.cur: Apa yang penting bagi Anda dalam kehidupan sehari-hari?

student:onboarding.steps.sponsor.subtitl.en: Universities and visa officers ask about financial support. Knowing your goal helps the Hangyul team guide you.
student:onboarding.steps.sponsor.subtitl.cur: Universitas dan petugas visa akan menanyakan dukungan keuangan. Dengan mengetahui tujuan Anda, tim Hangyul Univ bisa membantu Anda lebih baik.

student:register.captcha.text.cur: Langkah ini untuk mencegah pendaftaran otomatis.

student:register.captcha.unavailable.en: Sign-up is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
student:register.captcha.unavailable.cur: Pendaftaran tidak dapat dilakukan saat ini. Silakan coba lagi nanti.

student:register.consent.CROSS_BORDER_VE.en: I acknowledge that my email and mobile number are processed abroad to verify them
student:register.consent.CROSS_BORDER_VE.cur: Saya telah membaca pemberitahuan bahwa email dan nomor ponsel saya diproses di luar negeri untuk verifikasi identitas

student:register.consent.CROSS_BORDER_VE.en: Twilio Inc. (United States) delivers the verification text and email; Cloudflare, Inc. (United States) checks that sign-up is not automated. Details, including how to refuse, are in the Privacy Policy. Refusing means an account cannot be created.
student:register.consent.CROSS_BORDER_VE.cur: Twilio Inc. (Amerika Serikat) mengirim SMS dan email verifikasi, dan Cloudflare, Inc. (Amerika Serikat) memblokir pendaftaran otomatis. Item yang ditransfer, waktu, masa penyimpanan, dan cara menolak tercantum dalam Kebijakan Privasi. Jika menolak, akun tidak dapat dibuat.

student:register.consent.MARKETING.label.en: Send me study-in-Korea news and event information
student:register.consent.MARKETING.label.cur: Saya ingin menerima berita studi di Korea dan informasi acara

student:register.consent.MARKETING.summa.en: Optional. By email or text; unsubscribe any time.
student:register.consent.MARKETING.summa.cur: Opsional. Diterima melalui email atau SMS; dapat berhenti berlangganan kapan saja.

student:register.consent.PRIVACY.label.en: I agree to the collection and use of my personal information
student:register.consent.PRIVACY.label.cur: Saya menyetujui pengumpulan dan penggunaan data pribadi saya

student:register.consent.PRIVACY.summary.en: Email, mobile number, name, nationality and password (stored encrypted), to create and protect your account.
student:register.consent.PRIVACY.summary.cur: Email, nomor ponsel, nama, kewarganegaraan, dan hash kata sandi, untuk membuat dan melindungi akun Anda.

student:register.consent.TERMS.label.en: I agree to the Terms of Service

student:register.consent.canonical.en: The Korean text is the legally binding version; this translation is for your convenience.
student:register.consent.canonical.cur: Teks asli berbahasa Korea adalah dokumen resmi yang mengikat secara hukum; terjemahan ini hanya untuk kemudahan Anda.

student:register.consent.missing.en: Please agree to the required items.

student:register.consent.text.en: Required items are needed to open an account. You can withdraw optional consent at any time in Settings.
student:register.consent.text.cur: Anda harus menyetujui item wajib untuk membuat akun. Persetujuan opsional dapat ditarik kapan saja di Pengaturan.

student:register.consent.title.cur: Informasi pemrosesan data pribadi dan persetujuan

student:register.done.text.en: Your email and mobile number are verified. Let's find the programs that fit you.
student:register.done.text.cur: Email dan nomor ponsel Anda sudah terverifikasi. Mari temukan program yang cocok untuk Anda.

student:register.errors.generic.en: Something went wrong. Please try again.

student:register.errors.session.en: Your sign-up session expired. Start again.
student:register.errors.session.cur: Sesi pendaftaran telah berakhir. Silakan mulai lagi dari awal.

student:register.exists.en: An account with this email already exists. Try signing in instead.
student:register.exists.cur: Akun dengan email ini sudah ada. Coba masuk saja.

student:register.fromCheck.en: Your answers are saved to your profile, so your matches are ready as soon as you sign up.
student:register.fromCheck.cur: Jawaban Anda disimpan ke profil, jadi hasil kecocokan langsung siap begitu Anda mendaftar.

student:register.nameHint.cur: Sesuai yang tertulis di paspor Anda.

student:register.nationalityHint.en: Your nationality decides which documents and visa steps apply to you.
student:register.nationalityHint.cur: Kewarganegaraan Anda menentukan dokumen dan langkah visa yang berlaku untuk Anda.

student:register.passwordHint.en: At least 10 characters. A sentence you will remember works best.
student:register.passwordHint.cur: Minimal 10 karakter. Kalimat yang mudah diingat adalah pilihan terbaik.

student:register.phoneHint.en: We send a one-time code by text message. Standard rates may apply.
student:register.phoneHint.cur: Kami mengirim kode verifikasi melalui SMS. Tarif operator mungkin berlaku.

student:register.prior.EXPECTED.en: I'll finish before the program starts
student:register.prior.EXPECTED.cur: Saya akan lulus sebelum program dimulai

student:register.prior.why.en: The universities in your results require it. Your answer lets us confirm those programs right away. You can add your school and grades later.
student:register.prior.why.cur: Universitas dalam hasil Anda mensyaratkannya. Jawaban Anda membantu kami langsung memastikan program-program tersebut. Nama sekolah dan nilai bisa ditambahkan nanti.

student:register.privacyNote.en: Your documents and personal details are shared only with the Hangyul team that supports you (including its partner agency) and the universities you choose. You can export or delete your data at any time.
student:register.privacyNote.cur: Dokumen dan data pribadi Anda hanya dibagikan kepada tim Hangyul yang mendampingi Anda (termasuk agensi mitranya) dan universitas yang Anda pilih. Anda bisa mengekspor atau menghapus data Anda kapan saja.

student:register.subtitle.en: Four short steps. We verify your email and mobile number so your account and your documents stay yours.
student:register.subtitle.cur: Empat langkah singkat. Kami memverifikasi email dan nomor ponsel Anda agar akun dan dokumen Anda tetap menjadi milik Anda.

student:register.verify.consoleHint.en: Development: codes are not delivered. Use the development tools to read them.
student:register.verify.consoleHint.cur: Lingkungan pengembangan: kode tidak benar-benar dikirim. Lihat kode di alat pengembang.

student:register.verify.delivery.RECIPIE.cur: Kami tidak bisa mengirim email ke alamat ini. Mohon periksa kembali.

mobile:v4.documents.lateLine.en: flagged as late for the Hangyul team

mobile:v4.home.item.FIX.text.en: Your application can't be submitted until this is fixed.
mobile:v4.home.item.FIX.text.cur: Pendaftaran Anda tidak bisa dikirim sampai ini diperbaiki.

mobile:v4.home.item.LEGALIZE.text.en: Korean universities only accept this document once it's authenticated. We'll show you the steps for your country.
mobile:v4.home.item.LEGALIZE.text.cur: Universitas Korea hanya menerima dokumen ini setelah diautentikasi. Kami akan menunjukkan langkah-langkahnya untuk negara Anda.

mobile:v4.home.item.LEGALIZE.title.en: Get an apostille for your {{label}} for {{university}}

mobile:v4.home.item.RENEW.text.en: The one you uploaded has expired.
mobile:v4.home.item.RENEW.text.cur: Dokumen yang Anda unggah sudah kedaluwarsa.

mobile:v4.home.item.REQUEST.text.en: The university asked for this document. Your application can't move forward until it arrives.
mobile:v4.home.item.REQUEST.text.cur: Universitas meminta dokumen ini. Pendaftaran Anda tidak bisa berlanjut sampai dokumen ini diterima.

mobile:v4.home.item.REVISE_ESSAY.text.en: The Hangyul team left comments. Your application can't be submitted until it's approved.
mobile:v4.home.item.REVISE_ESSAY.text.cur: Konselor Anda meninggalkan komentar. Pendaftaran Anda tidak bisa dikirim sampai esai ini disetujui.

mobile:v4.home.item.TOO_OLD.text.en: The university needs a recently issued copy.
mobile:v4.home.item.TOO_OLD.text.cur: Universitas memerlukan salinan yang baru diterbitkan.

mobile:v4.home.item.UPLOAD.text.en: Your application can't be submitted without it.
mobile:v4.home.item.UPLOAD.text.cur: Pendaftaran Anda tidak bisa dikirim tanpa dokumen ini.

mobile:v4.home.item.WRITE_ESSAY.text.en: The Hangyul team will review it with you. Start with a rough draft. It doesn't need to be perfect.
mobile:v4.home.item.WRITE_ESSAY.text.cur: Konselor Anda akan meninjaunya bersama Anda. Mulailah dengan draf kasar. Tidak harus sempurna.

mobile:v4.reviews.tickAll.en: {{done}} of {{total}} checked. Complete every check to verify.
mobile:v4.reviews.tickAll.cur: {{done}} dari {{total}} sudah dicek. Selesaikan semua pengecekan untuk memverifikasi.
